title: 'Godmother of AI' Says Biggest AI Risk In Schools Is Students Losing the Desire to Learn - Slashdot

content_html:
Fei-Fei Li, aka The Godmother of AI, says the biggest AI risk in education may be students losing the motivation and agency to learn, rather than simply using the technology to cheat. She argues against banning AI outright, saying it can be valuable when used to support engaged students instead of replacing the thinking and struggle that learning requires. Techspot reports: Speaking on an episode of the science podcast Huberman Lab this week, Li talked about the fears around how students are using AI. "The absolute bad outcome is that our young generation, their agency and human-level motivation of learning and living is taken away by tools," the ImageNet inventor warned. "It should not be taken away by humans nor should it be taken away by machines." If we see a generation of graduates who have completely relied on AI without actively trying to learn anything for themselves, they risk leaving education without having "properly developed the brain," Li said.

[...] Li certainly isn't advocating for a complete ban on students using AI. She believes it can genuinely help struggling students who are already engaged in their learning. Li herself noted how she struggled with organic chemistry as a premed student, when teaching assistants and professors didn't have enough time to answer every question. While there's no obvious solution, Li says we need to find a way to keep children and students' motivation and agency. "Let's find a way to give them the access and the right way of using these tools," she said. Li added that if AI is used properly in education, it could make the students of the future "way smarter than us because they are superpowered."

sentences.zh: 李飞飞，又名人工智能教母，表示教育中人工智能最大的风险可能是学生失去学习的动力和机构，而不是简单地利用技术作弊。

sentences.en: She argues against banning AI outright, saying it can be valuable when used to support engaged students instead of replacing the thinking and struggle that learning requires.
sentences.zh: 她反对彻底禁止人工智能，并表示当人工智能被用来支持积极参与的学生而不是取代学习所需的思考和斗争时，人工智能可能会很有价值。

sentences.en: Techspot reports: Speaking on an episode of the science podcast Huberman Lab this week, Li talked about the fears around how students are using AI.
sentences.zh: Techspot 报道：李在本周的科学播客 Huberman Lab 的一集中谈到了对学生如何使用人工智能的担忧。

sentences.en: "The absolute bad outcome is that our young generation, their agency and human-level motivation of learning and living is taken away by tools," the ImageNet inventor warned.
sentences.zh: ImageNet 发明者警告说：“绝对糟糕的结果是，我们的年轻一代、他们的学习和生活的能动性和人类层面的动机被工具夺走了。”

sentences.en: "It should not be taken away by humans nor should it be taken away by machines."
sentences.zh: “它不应该被人类拿走，也不应该被机器拿走。”

sentences.en: If we see a generation of graduates who have completely relied on AI without actively trying to learn anything for themselves, they risk leaving education without having "properly developed the brain," Li said. [...]
sentences.zh: 李说，如果我们看到一代毕业生完全依赖人工智能而不积极尝试为自己学习任何东西，他们就有可能在没有“适当开发大脑”的情况下离开教育。 [...]

sentences.en: Li certainly isn't advocating for a complete ban on students using AI.
sentences.zh: 李当然并不是主张完全禁止学生使用人工智能。

sentences.en: She believes it can genuinely help struggling students who are already engaged in their learning.
sentences.zh: 她相信这可以真正帮助那些已经投入学习的困难学生。

sentences.en: Li herself noted how she struggled with organic chemistry as a premed student, when teaching assistants and professors didn't have enough time to answer every question.
sentences.zh: 李本人指出，作为一名医学预科学生，她在有机化学方面遇到了困难，当时助教和教授没有足够的时间来回答每一个问题。

sentences.en: While there's no obvious solution, Li says we need to find a way to keep children and students' motivation and agency.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有明显的解决方案，但李说，我们需要找到一种方法来保持儿童和学生的积极性和能动性。

sentences.en: "Let's find a way to give them the access and the right way of using these tools," she said.
sentences.zh: “让我们找到一种方法，让他们能够访问并以正确的方式使用这些工具，”她说。

sentences.en: Li added that if AI is used properly in education, it could make the students of the future "way smarter than us because they are superpowered."
sentences.zh: 李补充说，如果人工智能在教育中得到正确使用，它可以使未来的学生“比我们更聪明，因为他们拥有超能力”。

content_html_zh: 李飞飞，又名人工智能教母，表示教育中人工智能最大的风险可能是学生失去学习的动力和机构，而不是简单地利用技术作弊。 她反对彻底禁止人工智能，并表示当人工智能被用来支持积极参与的学生而不是取代学习所需的思考和斗争时，人工智能可能会很有价值。 Techspot 报道：李在本周的科学播客 Huberman Lab 的一集中谈到了对学生如何使用人工智能的担忧。 ImageNet 发明者警告说：“绝对糟糕的结果是，我们的年轻一代、他们的学习和生活的能动性和人类层面的动机被工具夺走了。” “它不应该被人类拿走，也不应该被机器拿走。” 李说，如果我们看到一代毕业生完全依赖人工智能而不积极尝试为自己学习任何东西，他们就有可能在没有“适当开发大脑”的情况下离开教育。 [...] 李当然并不是主张完全禁止学生使用人工智能。 她相信这可以真正帮助那些已经投入学习的困难学生。 李本人指出，作为一名医学预科学生，她在有机化学方面遇到了困难，当时助教和教授没有足够的时间来回答每一个问题。 虽然没有明显的解决方案，但李说，我们需要找到一种方法来保持儿童和学生的积极性和能动性。 “让我们找到一种方法，让他们能够访问并以正确的方式使用这些工具，”她说。 李补充说，如果人工智能在教育中得到正确使用，它可以使未来的学生“比我们更聪明，因为他们拥有超能力”。
